title: Macet
description: Jakarta's MRT digital signage runs on an autonomous AI-DLC V2 pipeline — software that builds itself through a team of AI agents. Today the pipeline is gridlocked. The Conductor agent is stuck, the FSM is looping, verification agents argue with generation agents, and the adaptive composer bloated a one-line fix to 32 stages. You've been called in as The Conductor — orchestrate the agents, clear the bottlenecks, and ship the release before Jakarta's rail network loses its digital backbone in 45 minutes.
